name: Gretex Corporate Services Ltd
title: Gretex Corporate Services Ltd - 543324 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Capital-markets merchant banker with no quantified Q1 FY27 results, guidance or capacity commentary; mainboard IPO activity slowed sharply versus FY26, and the only numeric outlook is 3-4 IPO listings this quarter.

triggers.label: Mainboard IPOs slowed vs FY26
triggers.quote: The mainb oard activity represents a significant and disciplined deceleration compared to the record -breaking volume of the preceding financial year

triggers.label: 3-4 IPO listings expected this quarter
triggers.quote: we expect a minimum of 3 to 4 IPO listings should happen

guidance.quote: we expect a minimum of 3 to 4 IPO listings should happen

summary.headline: Gretex Q1 FY27 call gave no financial figures; management cited 3 new advisory mandates and guided to 3-4 IPO listings in the current quarter.
summary.overview: Management (MD and CFO Alok Harlalka, WTD Arvind Harlalka) described a weak primary market in Q1 FY27, with 53 issues mobilising about INR 6,895 crores, of which 8 mainboard IPOs raised about INR 5,000 crores. The company reported 3 new advisory mandates, a listing mandate with a West Bengal ferroalloy company, and a DRHP filing for Sky Alloys and Power Limited. Bahutex received registration for a Category-II AIF with Gretex as a partner. The call contained no revenue, profit, or segment financials, and no quantified guidance.

segments.name: Merchant banking / advisory
segments.commentary: Signed 3 new advisory mandates in the quarter, secured a listing mandate with a West Bengal-based ferroalloy company, and filed DRHP for Sky Alloys and Power Limited on NSE and BSE.

segments.name: Broking and market-making (Gretex Share Broking Ltd)
segments.commentary: Subsidiary is preparing for a proposed listing; management called its contribution this quarter strong but gave no figures.

segments.name: Alternative investments
segments.commentary: Bahutex received registration for a Category-II AIF during the quarter, with Gretex as a partner in the fund.

guidance_outlook: Management expects a minimum of 3 to 4 IPO listings in the current quarter (Q2 FY27).
Management said it will build scale across merchant banking and broking in a measured and sustainable manner, with no quantified targets.
Management said the operating environment remains favourable, but gave no numerical outlook.
demand_pricing: Indian primary market in Q1 FY27: 53 issues mobilised about INR 6,895 crores; 8 mainboard IPOs raised about INR 5,000 crores and SME platform issues made up the balance across 45 issues.
Mainboard activity slowed sharply from FY26, when 108 mainboard companies raised over INR 1.76 lakh crores.
Secondary market liquidity described as stable, which management said supports broking and market-making.
Growing interest in mutual funds, PMS and alternative investment platforms noted; geopolitical uncertainty cited as a headwind.

qa_highlights.question: How many IPOs can be expected in the coming quarter? (submitted via chat)
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects a minimum of 3 to 4 IPO listings in the current quarter.

risks_watch: No revenue, PAT or segment numbers were disclosed on the call; the results document must be checked for these.
Mainboard IPO activity has decelerated sharply from FY26 levels, and geopolitical volatility persists.
Timing of the Gretex Share Broking Ltd listing is not specified.
Whether the Sky Alloys and Power DRHP and the 3-4 expected IPO listings convert into fee income this quarter is unclear.
Management did not quantify the contribution of the Bahutex AIF partnership.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the long-term outlook and origination pipeline, but vague on numbers: the call gave no financials and used qualitative terms such as 'measured' and 'favourable'. Management acknowledged the sharp slowdown in mainboard IPO activity without quantifying Gretex's exposure to it.
key_quotes: we remain confident in the long-term growth prospects of the Indian capital markets, and these structural trends remain well aligned with Gretex's integrated business model.
for the current quarter which is going on, we expect a minimum of 3 to 4 IPO listings should happen.

growth.why: No revenue or capacity figures given; management guided to a minimum of 3-4 IPO listings in Q2 FY27 and a measured scale-up with no quantified targets, while primary market activity slowed sharply from FY26.
